# recorded and bound, not inferred: nothing here claims to have observed the
# build. It must pin the toolchain and exactly match the reviewed manifest.
# Historical tagged diagnostics and newly reviewed default builds are allowed.
# repositories is `basename=commit` for every repository the manifest declares,
# in sorted order, and must be complete: the lowering runtime (sh) and every
# other replaced module the candidate links, filebrowser included.
